title: From Spectral to Frobenius: When Muon Loses Its Spectral Implicit Bias
abstract: arXiv:2610.20112v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Prior work on implicit bias shows that gradient descent selects the Frobenius max-margin direction on linearly separable problems, whereas Fan et al. (2025) established spectral max-margin behavior for spectral-norm steepest descent methods, including idealized Muon with exact orthogonalization. In practice, however, Muon approximates orthogonalization using finite Newton-Schulz iterations and a positive stabilization constant. We prove that these implementation choices cause Muon to select the Frobenius rather than the spectral max-margin direction in linear classification with separable data. We also establish this behavior for both exponential moving average and Nesterov-style momentum. The key technical ingredient is a summable perturbation argument showing that the resulting parameter trajectories remain at bounded distance from those of gradient descent. translated_title: 从谱范数到Frobenius范数：当Muon失去其谱隐式偏差时
translated_abstract: 关于隐式偏差的先前研究表明，梯度下降在线性可分问题上会选择Frobenius最大间隔方向，而Fan等人（2025）则为谱范数最速下降方法（包括采用精确正交化的理想化Muon）确立了谱最大间隔行为。然而在实践中，Muon使用有限次Newton-Schulz迭代和正的稳定化常数来近似正交化。我们证明，这些实现上的选择导致Muon在可分数据的线性分类任务中选择Frobenius最大间隔方向，而非谱最大间隔方向。我们还对指数移动平均和Nesterov式动量这两种情况确立了同样的行为。关键的技术要素是一个可求和的扰动论证，它表明所得的参数轨迹与梯度下降的参数轨迹之间保持有界距离。随后，我们厘清了Newton-Schulz迭代次数、稳定化常数等因素各自的作用。
tldr: 本文证明Muon优化器的实际实现（有限次Newton-Schulz迭代和正稳定化常数）会使其失去理论上的谱隐式偏差，转而像梯度下降一样选择Frobenius最大间隔方向。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that Muon's practical implementation choices—finite Newton-Schulz iterations and a positive stabilization constant—cause it to lose its spectral implicit bias and instead select the Frobenius max-margin direction like gradient descent.
